m2rc1-command-surface.description: The main window may invoke only commands declared in the application ACL manifest: production library and resource commands, the four probe commands, and the three M2-AC1 acceptance commands. RC-4 history, restore, and rerender commands, the M2-PAGE-RESOURCE-RESOLVE-1 page resolve, the M2-PAGE-NAV-PROJECTION-1 page navigation projections, HOST-ISSUER-1 user actions, the RUN-IPC-1 Run transport commands, and EXPORT-REVEAL-1 export-folder reveal are production-only. HostControl and opener plugin access remain internal to Rust.
